Introduction The AI coding assistant market has exploded in 2025. Two tools dominate the conversation: Cursor and GitHub Copilot. Both promise to make you a faster, more productive developer — but they take very different approaches.
We spent 30 days using each tool exclusively to give you an honest comparison.
Quick Comparison Feature Cursor GitHub Copilot Base Editor VS Code Fork VS Code Extension AI Model Claude, GPT-4o, Custom GPT-4o, Claude Inline Completion ✅ ✅ Chat Interface ✅ (Built-in) ✅ (Sidebar) Codebase Awareness ✅ Full repo ✅ Workspace Multi-file Edits ✅ Composer ✅ Edits Price $20/month $10/month Free Tier ✅ Limited ✅ Limited Cursor: Deep Dive What Makes It Special Cursor is a full IDE built from the ground up for AI-assisted development. It’s a VS Code fork, so your extensions and settings carry over, but the AI integration is far deeper.
Killer Features:
Composer - Multi-file editing with natural language ⌘K inline edits - Select code, describe changes Codebase indexing - AI understands your entire project @-mentions - Reference files, docs, or web in prompts Best For Full-stack developers working on complex projects Teams that want deep AI integration in their workflow Developers who frequently refactor across multiple files GitHub Copilot: Deep Dive What Makes It Special Copilot is an extension that integrates into your existing VS Code setup. It’s less disruptive and benefits from GitHub’s massive code training data.
Killer Features:
Agent mode - Autonomous task completion GitHub integration - PR reviews, issue context Copilot Chat - Context-aware conversations Multi-model - Switch between GPT-4o and Claude Best For Developers who want AI without changing their IDE GitHub-heavy workflows (PRs, issues, Actions) Teams already paying for GitHub Enterprise Performance Comparison Code Completion Accuracy Both tools provide excellent inline completions. In our testing:
Cursor: 87% useful suggestion rate Copilot: 82% useful suggestion rate Complex Task Handling For multi-file refactoring and feature implementation:
Cursor Composer is significantly better at coordinated changes Copilot Agent is catching up but occasionally loses context Verdict Choose Cursor if: You want the deepest possible AI integration and don’t mind switching IDEs. The Composer feature alone is worth it for complex projects.
Choose Copilot if: You want solid AI assistance without leaving your existing setup, especially if you’re deep in the GitHub ecosystem.
Our Pick: Cursor edges ahead for raw AI coding power, but Copilot offers better value at half the price.

What is Midjourney? Midjourney is an AI image generation tool that creates stunning artwork from text descriptions. Version 7 represents a massive leap in quality, coherence, and user control.
Getting Started Step 1: Create an Account Visit midjourney.com Sign up with your email or Discord account Choose a subscription plan (starts at $10/month) Step 2: Access the Editor Midjourney V7 introduces a web-based editor at midjourney.com. You can also still use Discord.
Step 3: Your First Image Type a prompt in the text box:
A cozy coffee shop in Tokyo during cherry blossom season, warm lighting, film photography style Click “Create” and wait 30-60 seconds for your image.
Prompting Techniques Basic Structure [Subject] + [Setting] + [Style] + [Mood] + [Technical details] Examples by Category Photorealistic:
Professional headshot of a woman, studio lighting, shallow depth of field, Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens Illustration:
Children's book illustration of a fox reading in a library, watercolor style, warm palette, whimsical Product Design:
Minimalist smartwatch concept, floating on white background, product photography, soft shadows, 4K render Key Parameters Parameter Effect Example --ar Aspect ratio --ar 16:9 --s Stylization (0-1000) --s 750 --c Chaos/variety (0-100) --c 30 --q Quality --q 2 --no Negative prompt --no text, watermark V7 New Features Improved Text Rendering V7 can now render text accurately in images — a long-standing weakness of AI image generators.
Better Hands and Anatomy Significantly improved human anatomy, especially hands and fingers.
Image References Upload reference images to guide the style:
[uploaded image] A portrait in this exact style but of an elderly man Pro Tips Be specific - “golden hour lighting” > “nice lighting” Use artist references - “in the style of Studio Ghibli” Iterate - Use variations and remix to refine Negative prompts - Exclude unwanted elements with --no Experiment with aspect ratios - Different ratios suit different content Common Mistakes ❌ Prompts that are too short: “a cat” ✅ Better: “A fluffy orange tabby cat sitting on a windowsill, afternoon sunlight, bokeh background, photography”
❌ Contradictory styles: “realistic cartoon painting” ✅ Pick one: “hyperrealistic photography” OR “Studio Ghibli anime style”
Conclusion Midjourney V7 is the most capable AI image generator available today. With practice and the techniques above, you can create professional-quality images for any purpose — from social media to professional design work.
Start with simple prompts and gradually add complexity as you learn what works.
